column1: # ---------------- THE AVERBAMENTOS, WHICH ARE THE POINT ----------------
*** 1 — SHE MARRIED FREDERICO PINTO DA ROCHA ON 18 NOVEMBER 1939 ***
column2: Casou civilmente com Frederico Pinto da Rocha, em 18 de Novembro de 1939, na 1.ª Conservatória do Registo Civil de Lourenço Marques. Transcribed into this assento on 7 May 1987.

column1: *** 2 — AND THAT MARRIAGE WAS DISSOLVED BY DIVORCE, SENTENCE OF 6 DECEMBER 1945 ***
column2: O casamento averbado sob o n.º 1 foi dissolvido por divórcio decretado por sentença de 6 de Dezembro de 1945, transitada em julgado. Averbamento entered 30 September 1987.

column1: 3 — and her full name was rectified
column2: Rectificado no sentido de que a registada casou com o nome completo de IVONE MATA DE FIGUEIREDO, na Conservatória do Registo Civil de Lourenço Marques, Moçambique. Processo 10.277/87. Em 9 de Outubro de 1987.

column1: *** "THERE WAS NEVER A DA ROCHA MARRIAGE" IS WRONG, AND THE FAMILY TREE WAS RIGHT ***
column2: this archive struck the tree's "Marriage to: Unknown Da Rocha, before 1941" as correction 9500002, on the strength of the Germiston register of February 1948 recording her as a SPINSTER, and published "She had never been married" and "there is no marriage record to find, because there was no marriage". THE MARRIAGE HAPPENED, THE REGISTRAR NAMED HIM, AND THERE IS A RECORD TO FIND: Lourenço Marques, 18 November 1939.

column1: how the two documents are reconciled
column2: THE GERMISTON ENTRY IS THE WEAKER INSTRUMENT. It records what was declared in a South African office in 1948 about a status acquired in another colony; the Portuguese assento is the continuously maintained register of her own civil status, carrying averbamentos added in 1987 and naming a court sentence with a date. A DIVORCÉE DECLARING HERSELF SINGLE ABROAD IS ORDINARY. A registrar inventing a husband, a wedding date, an office and a divorce decree is not.

column1: *** AND SHE WAS NOT A SPINSTER IN FEBRUARY 1948 — SHE WAS A DIVORCÉE OF TWO YEARS ***
column2: the divorce was final in December 1945 and she married Kurt Luwinski at Germiston in February 1948. The 2010 death certificate still records her estado civil as DIVORCIADO.

column1: # ---------------- AND THE CONSEQUENCE NOBODY HAS ASKED ABOUT ----------------
*** HENRIQUE WAS BORN INSIDE THE MARRIAGE ***
column2: HENRIQUE FIGUEIREDO PINTO DA ROCHA WAS BORN ON 11 MARCH 1941 — sixteen months after the wedding of 18 November 1939 and four years before the divorce. This archive published that he was born "to an unmarried mother" and that his father "gave him a surname and, on the evidence of that surname, acknowledged him". THE SIMPLER READING IS THAT HE CARRIES HIS FATHER'S SURNAME BECAUSE HIS PARENTS WERE MARRIED TO EACH OTHER WHEN HE WAS BORN.

column1: so his father has a forename now, and it is not an inference from a surname
column2: FREDERICO PINTO DA ROCHA. Not asserted as proved paternity — a husband is a presumption, not a certificate — but the marriage register of 18 November 1939 and Henrique's own birth registration at Lourenço Marques would both name him, and this archive has been saying the birth registration was "the only document likely to name his father".

column1: and her age was wrong by three years
column2: this archive published Henrique as born "to an unmarried mother of SIXTEEN" in one panel and "when she was SEVENTEEN" in another — the page contradicted itself, and both figures came from the 1924 birth year. BORN 4 MARCH 1922, SHE HAD TURNED NINETEEN SEVEN DAYS BEFORE HE WAS BORN.

column1: # ---------------- THE NAME, WHICH IS NOT SETTLED ----------------
*** AND AVERBAMENTO 3 DOES NOT JUST SPELL THE NAME, IT CERTIFIES THE SPELLING AS AN AMENDMENT ***
column2: Read at magnification 27 September: the endorsement ends "Em 9 de Outubro de 1987. EMENDEI: '3', '(três)' e 'MATA'." — the registrar recording, over his own signature, the words he had amended, AND ONE OF THE THREE IS THE NAME ITSELF. That is not a clerk writing a name in passing; it is a registrar correcting his own register on purpose and saying which word he corrected. IT IS THE STRONGEST SINGLE THING EITHER SIDE OF THIS DISPUTE HAS, and it is on the Mata side. The archive still publishes Mota and flags the panel Disputed, because the 1948 Transvaal court index reads Mota independently and three documents are not two.

column1: the full transcription and an English translation are now on her page
column2: All three Portuguese documents — the assento with its three averbamentos, the 2010 certificado de óbito and the declaração — are published on /ivone with the Portuguese AS WRITTEN beside a plain English rendering, so a reader who cannot read the hand or the language can check this archive's claims against the words rather than taking them on trust. Uncertain readings are marked [?] rather than smoothed.

column1: *** MATA OR MOTA — THE TWO CIVIL DOCUMENTS DISAGREE AND THIS ARCHIVE SHOULD NOT PICK ONE QUIETLY ***
column2: THE BIRTH ASSENTO SAYS MATA TWICE — the mother is "Leonia dos Santos Mata", and averbamento 3 is a deliberate legal act rectifying her full name to "Ivone MATA de Figueiredo". THE 2010 DEATH CERTIFICATE SAYS MOTA TWICE, typed — "Ivone MOTA de Figueiredo", mother "Leónia dos Santos MOTA". This archive publishes Mota and has a panel headed "Her name is Mota Figueiredo · Documented".

column1: which is likelier, and it is not decided here
column2: the 1987 averbamento is the more deliberate instrument — a rectification exists precisely to fix a name — and it is handwritten, which is where a and o confuse. The 2010 certificate is typed and legible but was filled from whatever the informant or a prior document supplied. THE DECIDER IS THE LOURENÇO MARQUES CERTIDÃO OF 14 OCTOBER 1974 that this assento was transcribed from, or the 1939 marriage entry.
